data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic word 'bal', meaning 'protector'. The suffix '-cer' denotes one who exalts or serves a higher power. The name Balcer carries the meaning “Exalted protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Balcer usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
